project: Tipiṭaka Hindi Translation Project (VRI Experiential Style)

books_completed.details: All 26 Vaggas translated with dual-layer rhythmic doha + prose in authentic VRI style.
Complete Mūlapariyāyasutta, Sabbāsavasutta, Dhammadāyādasutta, Bhayabheravasutta, Anaṅgaṇasutta, Ākaṅkheyyasutta, Vatthasutta, Sallekhasutta, and Sammādiṭṭhisutta.
Ganthārambhakathā (paras 0-25), Cakkhupāla, Maṭṭhakuṇḍalī, Tissa, and Kāḷayakkhinī commentaries.
Nidānakathā, First Council, Brahmajālasutta commentary (Paribbājakakathā, Cūḷasīla, Majjhimasīla, Mahāsīla, 62 Diṭṭhis, Phassapaccayavāra), and Sāmaññaphalasutta commentary.
Sub-commentary by Ācariya Dhammapāla: Ganthārambhakathā, Paṭhamamahāsaṅgītikathā, Brahmajālasuttavaṇṇanā, Cūḷasīla, Majjhimasīla, Mahāsīla, and 62 Diṭṭhis Ṭīkā.
Verañjakaṇḍaṃ, 1st Pārājika (Sudinna, monkey incident, legal definitions, Vinītavatthu precedents), and 2nd Pārājika (Dhaniya Kumbhakāraputta, King Bimbisāra, 5 māsakas rule).

Nidānādikathā (Antojaṭā bahijaṭā), Sīlaniddeso (essence, characteristic, function, manifestation, proximate cause, peerless cooling virtues exceeding Ganges and sandalwood), and Catupārisuddhisīla (Pātimokkha, Indriya, Ājīva, Paccayasannissita).
